## S&P Global Inc. (SPGI) `[Financial Information & Analytics]`
- S&P Global announced integration of Visible Alpha broker-sourced consensus estimates and granular line-item data into its AI Data Portal, covering more than 8,000 companies across 170-plus industries and making the data available through enterprise AI workflows. (Pluang, Oct 15, 2026; publish time not reported)[8]
- Reports attributed the move to positive sentiment around S&P Global’s AI-data expansion and integration with Capital IQ Pro, alongside a reported 2.15% rise in the Industrial & Commercial Services sector. (Mitrade, Oct 15, 2026; publish time not reported)[6]
- SPGI closed at $424.81, up 4.27% on the verified tape; a contemporaneous market report cited a 4.09% gain and a $424.81 price. (GuruFocus, Oct 15, 2026; publish time not reported)[7]
- S&P Global’s AI-data announcement was associated with a reported delayed price of $424.68 and a $405.11–$425.78 session range; the report listed relative volume at 1.6× average. (Stock Titan, Oct 15, 2026; publish time not reported)[10]
- Recent analyst concerns cited by a market report included JPMorgan and BMO Capital Markets lowering SPGI price targets because of reduced third-quarter earnings estimates and possible reductions to full-year Ratings-segment growth guidance ahead of the October 27 earnings report; the report did not provide the old and new targets or ratings. (TradingKey, Oct 15, 2026; publish time not reported)[9]
- One market report gave a recent analyst-target range of $477–$629, with an average target of $519.38. (TradingKey, Oct 15, 2026; publish time not reported)[9]
